name: Cupid’s Deceit
source:
As a professional matchmaker with a budding agency, finding love is all in a day’s work. When a wealthy business man comes to you with a lucrative offer, it almost seems too good to be true – convince his eligible bachelor of a son to open his heart within six months, and you’ll have more than enough to buy back your childhood home. Too bad the charming face he presents in public is nothing but a thin veneer over stubborn arrogance.

Still, they say opportunity makes strange bedfellows, so when your mark proposes you fake an engagement long enough to appease his father and see you both paid out, how can you refuse? From that fateful moment on, the clock is ticking for you to either find him a genuine match or be forced to go through with your deception… but what if fate has other plans?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.marriagehunter]Google Play[/url]]
